'''Shesta Kancen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who held the title of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] within the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Battle of Corellia]] in the [[Galactic War]], he was stationed at the [[Coronet City Spaceport/Legends|Coronet Spaceport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], where he shared his knowledge with fellow [[Sith Inquisitor]]s.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lord Shesta Kancen appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a class trainer for the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Inquisitor class on Corellia.<ref name="TOR" />
